brand_identity.name: VELARYON
brand_identity.creative_direction: CINEMATIC MARITIME × ADVANCED ROBOTICS × EDITORIAL MINIMALISM × PRECISION ENGINEERING
brand_identity.tone_and_voice: Authoritative, restrained, engineered, cinematic, forward-looking. Uses precise early-stage language ('designed to', 'intended to', 'being developed for', 'concept') with zero fluff or fabricated metrics.

logo_specifications.mark: Dark steel-blue 'V' ship-bow mark with two hydro-dynamic wake waves beneath it
logo_specifications.rule: Never recolor, distort, or invert the bow mark. Preserve dark steel-blue tint against deep dark or stark bright backgrounds.

colors.section_rhythm: Strict alternating rhythm between dark cinematic sections (deep navy #090d16 / near black #05070a) and stark bright editorial sections (#f4f5f7 / #fcfdfd). Avoid continuous dark overload.

typography.heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk / Playfair Display / Cormorant Garamond for high-impact editorial titles
typography.body_font: Inter / IBM Plex Sans for technical precision and extreme readability
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono / Source Code Pro for telemetry, chapter labels, and specifications

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-[0.95]
scale.chapter_number: font-mono text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500
scale.body_text: text-base sm:text-lg leading-relaxed text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-300 light:text-slate-700

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: HEAVY, CONTROLLED, PRECISE, ENGINEERED. Avoid springy SaaS bounces. Use cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) or cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1) ease curves.

signature_loading_experience.sequence:
1. Screen begins near-black (#05070a) with faint oceanic wave audio/visual grid.
2. Ship/bow portion of VELARYON 'V' logo approaches slowly from the horizon.
3. Waves animate as a wake originating at the bow and propagating outward in crisp vector geometry.
4. Resolves into exact logo geometry.
5. Logo smoothly scales down and glides directly into the top-left navbar position while the ocean hero scene reveals underneath. No page fade out.

microinteractions.buttons: Editorial rectangular buttons with sharp or subtle 2px corner radius, magnetic text alignment, and right arrow offset movement on hover ('EXPLORE PLATFORM ↗').
microinteractions.links: Refined underline animation expanding from left to right with 1px offset.
microinteractions.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll enabled across all pages for weighty momentum.

layout_and_structure.grid_strategy: Asymmetric Swiss editorial grid with heavy negative space, thin 1px precision grid lines, and crisp alignment bounds.

home_page: Hero: Full-bleed cinematic ocean vessel render + 'AUTONOMOUS MARITIME SYSTEMS' + 'Intelligence at Sea.' + 'EXPLORE VELARYON ↓'
01 / MISSION: Dark cinematic ocean scale visualization — how vastness demands autonomous endurance
02 / PLATFORM: Bright off-white technical environment, large side-profile vessel diagram with interactive annotation lines (SENSING / COMPUTE / NAVIGATION / COMMUNICATION / MISSION SYSTEMS)
03 / AUTONOMY Teaser: Full-screen sequential text trigger (PERCEIVE → UNDERSTAND → DECIDE → ACT)
04 / TECHNOLOGY: Asymmetric 4-pillar grid (AUTONOMY, PERCEPTION, INTELLIGENCE, CONNECTIVITY)
05 / MISSIONS: Interactive operational scenarios (MARITIME AWARENESS, INFRASTRUCTURE MONITORING, OCEAN INTELLIGENCE, MARITIME SECURITY)
Engineering Philosophy: Large typography display section ('Autonomous by design / Software at the core / Adaptable by architecture')
06 / FORWARD Roadmap: Thin animated progress line from CONCEPT → ENGINEERING → PROTOTYPE → SEA TRIALS → MISSION VALIDATION → SCALE
07 / VELARYON Company: Bright editorial startup section with founder/team portraits & investor focus
Final CTA: Cinematic ocean horizon with traveling vessel ('The next era begins at sea.' + 'START A CONVERSATION ↗')
Footer: Minimalistic precision footer with telemetry indicators and legal disclosures
page_structure.how_it_works_page: Dedicated 7-stage sticky scrollytelling experience: MISSION → DEPLOY → PERCEIVE → UNDERSTAND → DECIDE → ACT → CONNECT → MISSION COMPLETE.

media_assets.usage_instructions: Use hero_vessel for full-bleed background hero with poster crossfade. Use ocean_dark_waves for scale & autonomy sections. Use team portraits in bright editorial card layouts.

accessibility_and_testing.prefers_reduced_motion: Disable smooth scroll and complex SVG wake particle animations when prefers-reduced-motion is active. Provide instant loader finish.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attribute_requirement: All interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and key metric labels MUST contain unique kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-explore-button', data-testid='contact-form-submit').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_standards: Ensure high contrast WCAG AA on all dark text over bright sections and white text over dark navy/black sections.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement Lenis smooth scrolling for weighted cinematic page feel.
Build the custom 2.8s SVG bow-wake intro loader that seamlessly moves into the fixed navbar position.
Ensure contrast alternating sections: dark cinematic hero -> bright off-white platform section -> dark autonomy section -> bright editorial company section.
Never use generic rounded SaaS cards or neon cyberpunk glows.
Use data-testid attributes on all key interactive elements across home, mission, platform, technology, how-it-works, company, and contact pages.
